title: Data Analyst
summary: Data analysts turn raw data into answers a team can act on, using spreadsheets, SQL, Python and dashboards. It suits students who like asking questions, spotting patterns and explaining findings clearly, and it is open to any branch.

sources.title: How to Become a Data Analyst with No Experience – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Spreadsheets: formulas and pivot tables
nodes.summary: Learn to sort, filter, write common formulas (lookups, IF, SUMIFS) and build pivot tables in Excel or Google Sheets. Spreadsheets are still the everyday tool in most analyst jobs.
nodes.proof: A cleaned spreadsheet of a public dataset with a pivot table and a one-paragraph summary of what it shows.

nodes.title: SQL for analysis
nodes.summary: Write SELECT queries with filters, GROUP BY, JOINs, subqueries and window functions. SQL is usually tested in analyst interviews, so learn it early and practise a lot.

resources.title: CS50's Introduction to Databases with SQL – Harvard

nodes.proof: A set of 20 or more SQL queries answering business questions on a sample database, saved in a GitHub repository.

sources.title: How to Become a Data Analyst with No Experience – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Statistics you will actually use
nodes.summary: Cover averages, spread, distributions, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests and simple regression. This lets you say whether a change is real or just noise.
nodes.proof: A short write-up testing one claim on real data (for example, whether two groups differ), with the test used and the result explained.

nodes.title: Python with pandas
nodes.summary: Learn Python basics, then use pandas to load, filter, group and reshape tables. Python handles data that is too big or too messy for a spreadsheet.

resources.title: Kaggle Learn (free Python and pandas courses)

nodes.proof: A Jupyter notebook that loads a CSV, answers five questions with pandas and explains each answer in plain words.

nodes.title: Dashboards with Power BI
nodes.summary: Learn to prepare data with Power Query, build a data model, write simple DAX measures and design clear report pages. Dashboards are how most analysts share results.

resources.title: Power BI Data Analyst learning catalog – Microsoft Learn

nodes.proof: A one-page dashboard on a public dataset with filters and three key measures, plus screenshots in your portfolio.

sources.title: Power BI Data Analyst learning catalog – Microsoft Learn

nodes.title: Data cleaning and exploratory analysis
nodes.summary: Practise fixing missing values, duplicates and wrong types, then explore data with summaries and charts before drawing conclusions. Real data is messy, and this is most of the job.

resources.title: Learn Data Analysis with Python – freeCodeCamp

nodes.proof: A notebook that takes a messy public dataset, documents every cleaning step and ends with three charts and findings.

nodes.title: Two or three end-to-end analysis projects
nodes.summary: Pick datasets you care about, ask a clear question, then clean, analyse and present the answer with SQL, Python and a dashboard. A small, finished portfolio matters more than a long list of courses.
nodes.proof: A GitHub repository or portfolio page with 2–3 projects, each with the question, the method, a chart and the conclusion.

nodes.title: Asking business questions and presenting findings
nodes.summary: Practise turning a vague request into a clear question, and explaining results to non-technical people in a few slides or a short note. Interviewers often check this as much as tools.

resources.title: What Does a Data Analyst Do? – roadmap.sh

nodes.proof: A 5-minute recorded walkthrough or a one-page summary of one project written for a manager, not an engineer.

sources.title: What Does a Data Analyst Do? – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Interview preparation and applying
nodes.summary: Revise common analyst questions on cleaning, statistics and visualisation, practise SQL query questions under time, and be ready to walk through your projects. Then apply for internships and entry-level analyst roles.

resources.title: 50 Popular Data Analyst Interview Questions – roadmap.sh
30 SQL Queries Interview Questions and Answers – roadmap.sh

nodes.proof: Answer the roadmap.sh question set out loud with a friend, and solve the SQL query questions without looking at answers.
